about: Rules from apps/shop/ROUTES.md and the planted bugs that break each one. Saboteur's report uses this to show which rules would break without any test noticing. M11 to M13 were found by the duel's red team.

requirements.text: Total = subtotal - discount + shipping, and the subtotal counts every line in the cart
Shipping is $5.00 when the subtotal after discount is under $50.00, otherwise free
Code SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal
Checkout only accepts an email like name@domain.tld
The cart is saved and survives a page refresh
The quantity stepper changes the quantity (min 1, max 9)
"Remove" removes that line from the cart
Out-of-stock products cannot be added to the cart
The confirmation page shows an order number like SAB-123456
The header cart badge shows the number of items in the cart
Wrong sign-in details show "Email or password is incorrect"
